design_philosophy: A warm, friendly, and child-centric mobile app design that feels safe, inviting, and professional. It balances the playful energy of preschool with the clean, trustworthy organization required by parents and school staff.

primary.description: Klinara Teal - Core brand color used for primary buttons, prominent headers, and key active states.

background.description: Cream - Universal app background color. Warm and easy on the eyes.

accent_1.description: Golden - Used for highlights, stars, Elthea GROW chart accents, and secondary actions.

accent_2.description: Beige - Neutral supportive color for cards, tags, and subtle backgrounds.

accent_3.description: Rose - Used for warnings, alerts, or emotional highlights.

accent_4.description: Blush Pink - Soft pastel highlight for child-friendly UI elements, badges, and avatars.

surface.description: Pure white for cards and floating components to stand out against the Cream background.

headings.description: Used for Screen Titles, Brand marks, and major headers. Conveys the 'Klinara Kids' classic brand.

body.description: Clean, highly readable, and friendly sans-serif for all body text, buttons, and inputs.

layout_and_spacing.safe_area: Ensure SafeAreaView is used on all screens to prevent overlap with notches.

buttons.primary: bg-[#2f6b6b] text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 items-center justify-center shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-[#d4a574] text-white rounded-full py-4 px-6 items-center justify-center shadow-sm
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#2f6b6b] text-[#2f6b6b] rounded-full py-4 px-6 items-center justify-center
rules: Equal-sized buttons on selection screens (e.g., Parent vs Staff role selection).
Always rounded-full for a friendly, soft look.

cards.default: bg-white rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-sm border border-[#e5dfd3]
rules: Soft shadows (elevation: 2 on Android, shadowOpacity: 0.05 on iOS).

inputs.default: bg-white border border-[#e5dfd3] rounded-2xl px-5 py-4 text-base text-[#1a3a3a]

grow_chart.description: Elthea AI Assessment Chart. A beautiful, smooth radial or horizontal bar chart.
grow_chart.style: Rounded bar caps, soft gradients if possible, playful but clear data representation.

role_selection.layout: Centered content. Logo at the top, welcome text, followed by two large, equal-sized square or wide buttons for 'Parent' and 'School Staff'.

parent_dashboard.layout: Vertical scroll. Welcome Header -> Child Profile Header Card -> GROW Chart Summary Card -> Quick Actions (Attendance, Fees) -> Recent Activities Feed.

activity_feed.card_style: Image taking full width of the card, rounded top corners, caption and date below in a white padded area.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React Native StyleSheet or NativeWind/Tailwind depending on setup, but rigidly follow the provided hex codes.
Implement navigation using Expo Router or React Navigation.
Make sure UI components (Buttons, Inputs, Cards) are exported as reusable React Native components.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive components like buttons, inputs, and list items for robust automated testing.
For the Elthea AI GROW assessment, if a charting library is needed, use `react-native-svg` or `react-native-chart-kit` and customize it with pastel colors from the palette.
